agent: Claude Sonnet 5.5, one run per tool, the three runs in parallel on one machine
source: Each agent's own trial-log.md: tool calls as it counted them, seconds from its date +%s stamps. Total seconds run from the first stamp to the last, so they include the gaps between tasks.

tasks.title: Find and fix what does not fit
Deliver an offline folder with notes
Say whether the copy is stale

create.note: The brief's 138-character heading fails check (headings stop at 90), so nothing could render until it was shortened.

revise.note: rev and apply refuse a deck with a check error, so the heading was fixed by hand outside apply first.

check.note: The tool's measurements found nothing. Looking at the images found the source line printed three times; one op removed the extra.

deliver.note: export made a three-file folder that opens from file:// with no network. Notes show in the same window, no presenter view.

recover.note: A stale base revision was refused with exit 3 and nothing was written.

create.note: No chart element, so a Vue and SVG component was written by hand. The Google Fonts default was switched off in the config.

revise.note: A speaker note still said sixty to forty; the agent left it because the brief said to change nothing else.

check.note: Slidev has no overflow check. The agent wrote its own measuring script; nothing overflowed.

deliver.note: The documented build is blank from file://. It opened after a Vite config plugin and a post-build script, neither in the docs.

recover.note: No revision or conflict signal; the agent proposed hashing the file.

create.note: No component gives a heading with bullets or a labelled chart, so three slide builders were written by hand.

revise.note: One edit to one slide file.

check.note: No check command. The agent's own render scripts found the presenter window cropping slides, and fixed it in CSS.

deliver.note: No export-to-folder command; a script the agent wrote assembled the folder. The deck opens on a welcome screen that waits for a key.

recover.note: No revision; last write wins. The agent proposed hashing the file.
